learn.en: The Prophet ﷺ was born on a Monday in the Year of the Elephant, about 55 days after Abraha's attack.
learn.title: A blessed birth

learn.en: His mother Aminah named him Ahmad after a dream; his grandfather Abdul-Muttalib named him Muhammad, wishing that the whole world would praise him.
learn.title: Ahmad and Muhammad

learn.en: His father Abdullah, of the Quraysh tribe, died at 25 before he was born. Haleemah Sa'diyyah nursed him for four years, and he tended sheep with other boys.
learn.title: With Haleemah

learn.en: At six he visited relatives in Madinah and learnt to swim! On the way back his mother died at Abwa. His grandfather cared for him until he died, when the Prophet ﷺ was eight.
learn.title: Losses in childhood

learn.en: Then he lived with his uncle Abu Talib. As a boy he never did mischief or quarrelled, and he liked to help his uncle. Allah protected him from all evil.
learn.title: A boyhood like no other

learn.en: “And We have not sent you, O Muhammad, except as a mercy to the worlds.” (Qur'an 21:107)
learn.title: From the Qur'an

quiz.en: Abu Talib was the Prophet's ﷺ…
What did the Prophet ﷺ learn in Madinah at six?

think.q: As a boy, the Prophet ﷺ never quarrelled and loved helping his uncle. How can you be like him at home?
think.a: Help without being asked, and stay calm instead of arguing.

parents.summary: Born in the Year of the Elephant; named Ahmad by Aminah and Muhammad by Abdul-Muttalib; raised by Haleemah, then his grandfather, then his uncle Abu Talib.
parents.tip: Draw the Prophet's ﷺ family tree together.
